system.description:
You begin knowing 3 Devices from the list below. Deploying a Device requires an action.

A Device is deployed into the scene and remains until destroyed, recalled, or the scene ends. You may only have one Device deployed at a time. Devices have a range upon which you can control them.

Choose three:

  • Recon Drone: Reveals hidden enemies and grants information about the battlefield. Far range.

  • Repair Drone: Repairs equipment or restores HP to an adjacent ally. Far range, restores 1d4 HP once.

  • Barrier Projector: Creates temporary cover from ranged attacks. Very Close range, @Template[type:circle|range:m], 14 Evasion, can sustain 5 hits.

  • Flash Emitter: Distracts nearby enemies. Far range, @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart.consumables.eAXHdzA5qNPldOpn]{Blinding Orb} on trigger and then the device is destroyed.

  • Sensor Node: Detects invisible or concealed creatures. This device cannot move, you receive a notification as long as you are within Very Far range.

  • Decoy Projector: Creates a convincing holographic distraction. Attack against allies within Melee range of the Decoy have disadvantage.

Unless otherwise specified, devices cannot move or attack by thelselves, are destroyed if they take any damage, have an evasion of 10. A Device may only be Activated once each round and activating a Device requires an Action.
